title: Teodoro says Philippines, allies now ‘better prepared’ for any crisis

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro, Jr. said on Monday that the Philippines and its security partners are now “better prepared” to respond to any potential crisis, and expressed confidence that the United States would come to Manila’s aid should a conflict arise. The Philippines has sought to expand its network of allies in the face of China’s coerciveness in the West Philippine Sea, Manila’s term for the parts of the South China Sea within its exclusive economic zone that Beijing also claims. “If there’s a flash, at least we are better prepared to deal with it,” Teodoro said, though […]...
